name: Resume a book exactly where reading stopped
audience: A person reading one long-form EPUB over several sittings on a Linux desktop
objective: Reopen the same book days later and land on the exact passage where reading stopped, even after the typography changed
workflow: Open one EPUB from the file chooser; it renders as a paginated reading surface with a progress slider and table of contents
Turn pages or scroll to read; each relocation updates that book's own JSON file with progress and the CFI of the current position
Close the application, then reopen the same file
Change font size or margins; the book re-paginates but the saved position still points at the same text
acceptance: Reopening the same EPUB restores the same passage (CFI), not merely a similar percentage
Each book keeps its own position: a second book opens at its own last position, unaffected by the first
The stored position is a text anchor, so it survives a font-size change that alters the page count
Page turns and the progress slider visibly change the position value stored in that book's JSON file
